claim: Locate the first failing boundary between serialization, teacher-forced learning, prompt conditioning and free generation before changing the mouth architecture or running 303M again.

execution.entry: anima-py and the existing Python core only
execution.models_and_training_data: private Hugging Face dancinlab repositories only

views.probe: first eight SHA-ordered single-exchange training documents

model.schedule: 50-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio
model.chat_objective: assistant-turn-only supervises payload, internal newlines and next canonical user-role delimiter

D0.name: decoder and serialization bisimulation
comparisons: Torch checkpoint logits versus serialized engine logits on the same fixed prefixes
resident engine KV decode versus full-forward engine decode
ranged canonical generator versus resident engine generated bytes
D0.gate: all argmax bytes identical; max Torch-engine logit error <= 0.0001
D0.failure: fix the shared serializer/decode path and rerun D0 before interpreting D1-D6

D1.name: gold-prefix teacher-forcing trace
D1.input: the same failed checkpoint and eight frozen probes
measures: gold byte mean probability and rank
D1.classification: teacher-forced top-1 < 0.80 means learning/optimization failure; >= 0.80 with free target-prefix < 6/8 means rollout/exposure failure after D0 passes

D2.name: memorization ladder
D2.unchanged: initial weights by seed, optimizer, schedule, batch, block, sampler and decode
D2.measures: D1 metrics and free target-prefix/structural results on up to eight in-view probes
D2.purpose: identify the first registered document count where teacher-forced or free recovery collapses

D3.name: objective comparison
arms: additive full CE plus assistant CE
D3.reuse: the D2 100-document assistant-turn-only run is the third arm
D3.promotion_rule: a full-CE-first curriculum is supported only if a full-containing arm reaches teacher-forced top-1 >= 0.80 and free target-prefix >= 6/8 while turn-only does not

D4.name: prompt conditioning intervention
D4.gate: normal gold-response CE is lower than both controls on at least 6/8 probes and normal free outputs are not invariant to both controls
D4.purpose: separate prompt-conditioned learning from response-byte frequency modeling

D5.name: fixed validation replay
D5.input: all 32 frozen validation documents in SHA order
D5.purpose: replace random four-batch diagnostic noise without changing any training gradient or prior verdict

D6.name: checkpoint temporal trace
measures: repeated byte and repeated phrase run length
top-1 versus top-2 margin at the first divergence
D6.restriction: diagnostic only; no post-hoc best-checkpoint promotion

bounded_work.arm_accounting: six D2 ladder arms plus full and additive D3 arms; D2-100 is reused for D3 turn-only and D6

decision_table.D0_PASS_D1_LOW: checkpoint did not learn the gold conditional distribution sufficiently
decision_table.D2_EARLY_COLLAPSE: tiny optimization/capacity or conditioning failure before broad data scale
decision_table.D3_FULL_CONTAINING_ONLY_PASS: support full-CE pretraining before turn specialization
decision_table.D4_FAIL: prompt is not causally controlling response content
decision_table.D6_REPETITION_AFTER_LEARNING: late attractor formation; report chronology without selecting a checkpoint
